content:
Navigation app Waze is rolling out updates for its iPhone and Android apps, adding three new AI features.

The first feature will use your driving history to understand your route preferences and provide personalized navigation options...

The company says these personalized routes will be offered in priority over standard routes.

You can also use the Gemini-powered chat feature to find suitable destinations.

The conversational reporting feature is being expanded to cover permanent changes, such as road closures or business closures.

If you prefer fewer conversations rather than more, Waze also offers a "fewer conversations" mode.

Finally, Waze is beginning to roll out an AI-powered motorcycle navigation feature.

However, the latter feature is not yet available in the United States, initially limited to Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, Malaysia, Mexico, Peru, and the Philippines.
